correctness.rationale: The complementary-modulus expansions give alpha=(4/pi)[1+tau^2(3/4-L/2)+O(tau^4 L)] and beta=(4 tau/pi)[L-1+tau^2(3L/4-1)+O(tau^4 L)], so K tau(L-1)=1+O(tau^2 L). The lower Lambert branch therefore yields tau_K=1/(K Y_K)(1+O(1/(K^2Y_K))). Substitution gives the stated two-term deficit. The boundary L2 identity follows from an elementary symmetric integral and its Taylor expansion gives the stated rate.

originality.rationale: The existing same-day SCOPE record `concavity-logarithmic-harmonic-distortion-constant--a851edb91438` already contains the Lambert-W inversion, the 2/(pi K^2 log K) deficit, and the exact quantitative L2 degeneration, while also proving stronger global information such as strict concavity and endpoint derivative laws. Thus every principal contribution of this package is subsumed.

scientific_value.rationale: Although the asymptotics are useful and correct, maintaining this weaker package as a separate validated record would duplicate a stronger accepted result on the same extremal constant and boundary family.
